opening.argument: The presentation offers an easy route to passive income through Uniswap, then directs viewers to deploy a contract and deposit at least 0.2 ETH to its address. It explains that the bot will place a transaction first, send a sell order in the same block, and profit when another transaction is sandwiched between them through the slippage difference. The requested funding is tied directly to the claimed returns: the more deposited, the larger the transaction that can be front run and the more profit accumulated over time. Although the speaker concedes that profitability fluctuates from week to week, that qualification does not remove the direct solicitation based on the bot's asserted profit mechanism and returns.

citations.quote: I'll be explaining to you an easy method to make passive income using Uniswap.
Deposit funds (at least 0.2 ETH to prevent negating slippage) to your exact contract/bot address
the more you put in, the larger the transaction you will be able to front run. And the more profit you will be able to accumulate over time.
So basically the victims transaction gets sandwiched between ours and we make a profit from the slippage difference in the transaction.
